scripts.build: npm ci --prefix crm --no-audit --no-fund && npm run typecheck --prefix crm && npm run build --prefix crm -- --base=/crm/ && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');fs.rmSync('outputs',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist','outputs',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('crm/build','outputs/crm',{recursive:true});if(!fs.existsSync('outputs/index.html')||!fs.existsSync('outputs/crm/index.html'))process.exit(1);console.log('OK: site e CRM em outputs/')"
